market_outlook.short_term: Bond yield volatility dominates; oil above $100-103 keeps inflation fears alive. Equities choppy as bond selloff alternates with relief rallies. Yen intervention risk creates FX volatility. European stocks find footing but consumer weakness caps upside. AI names resilient but rotation within sector (optics, networking) intensifies. 2-3 week window of elevated volatility before Trump-Xi truce provides 2-month calm.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle continues but fragmentation creates winners/losers. Commodity supply shocks (El Niño, energy) support 2027 inflation. Housing affordability crisis structural. Defense spending multiyear cycle intact. Trade truce extension buys time but structural US-China tensions persist. Energy transition policy fatigue may slow green capex. Bond market at 20-year highs suggests rate normalization incomplete.
